hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook that routes swaps through Euler lending vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes input/output amounts using a custom bonding curve (CurveLib), deposits input tokens into the Euler vault, and withdraws output tokens from the Euler vault, fully handling swaps via BeforeSwapDelta. Native Uniswap v4 concentrated liquidity is intentionally blocked.
